theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cipi_imrep_weight_const_nat
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U m) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → MeasurableSet S → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict S) K < ∞) → (∃ (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict S) (ball x r)) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → R.measure G = ENNReal.ofReal c * ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict S) G) → ∃ k : ℕ, c = k
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
